notes.title: Steam Next Fest: February 2025 - Live Demo Showcase and Q&A
notes.content:
Hi! I will be participating in the Steam Next Fest with the demo of Luciferian from 2/24, until 3/3. I will be streaming live shortly after the festival begins, playing the demo, commenting on features and mechanics, and interacting with you in the chat.
Some previously unseen features and walkthroughs from levels 3 to 7 will be shown, exclusively for those who join the stream.

Live stream schedule:

- Europe (CET): 22:00
- Pacific Standard Time (PST): 16:00
- Uruguay/Argentina (UYT / ART): 19:00

For more information about the event and to explore the titles by genre, visit - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest?tab=22]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest?tab=22[/url]

Available for PC/Windows during 2025.
Wishlist on Steam - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2241230/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2241230/[/url]
Demo available for download.

See you there!
